title: GREAT EXPERIMENTS IN BIORESOURCE SCIENCES
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 4 credits
description: For students interested in BRR and undergraduate research, to introduce the research process and help them start defining research interests and project areas. Faculty describe research projects and experimental approaches, and pose interesting political and ethical questions related to scientific research. Students work with junior and senior student mentors already involved in research projects.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 4pm-4:50pm in STAG 160 - Strand Agriculture Hall 160 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
